extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / users attempting to create or find an article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users who search for or attempt to create a new Wikipedia article/page, including account requirements, searching existing content, redirects, and troubleshooting why a title may not appear.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement to create pages
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users who wish to create an article must have an account and meet autoconfirmed status (i.e., account age/edit count threshold).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article if you cannot create it
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you lack permissions or prefer guided creation, use the wizard or request process so experienced editors can assist or review drafts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Comedy 2025 Trump" in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, verify whether the topic already exists under a different title or spelling to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages that link to the intended title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding inbound links can indicate the subject is covered elsewhere or that redirects may be appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account for propagation delays and try purging
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you expect a freshly created page but can't see it, allow time for the database to update or purge the cache to force refresh.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirect consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new title, verify capitalization variants and create redirects where appropriate to help users find the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if the page has been deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewing the deletion log and explanations can reveal policy reasons (notability, copyright, etc.) and inform how to improve or re-request the page.
